title: Moreish Puff Chilled Blue Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: One of the most popular e-liquid flavours gets the Moreish Puff Nic Salt treatment in Chilled Blue Raspberry. Rich blueberries, tangy raspberries and a layer of cool, refreshing menthol come together to create an endlessly sweet and satisfying vape. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
